pick.headline: China announces withdrawal from Vietnam
pick.summary: On 5 March 1979 China announced it was withdrawing its troops from Vietnam after a month-long incursion.
pick.significance: Beijing claimed to have taught Hanoi a lesson, but the war was costly and inconclusive.
